blocks.text: Queue jump, fourteen dollars and sixty seven cents, was printed under the tag on the item page for Loom woven placemat, set of 2.
The amount due on this screen is that same quote. Nothing further is introduced here.
Beeswax puck at $14.53 is offered and the box is empty, so it stays off the amount due.
Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.

product.description: The placemats are loom woven and sold as a pair.
